name: Rows 155 to 168, the review page and the mechanics page beside the destinations and feedback pages, eleven instrument extensions, thirteen findings routed, "review" and "points" as vocabulary lines, and the no-pay-input rule beside the other structural rules
text_content:
Routed to: S17 (86ajgmk27)

The readiness test stands at one hundred and sixty-eight rows; rows 160, 161, 163, 166, and 168 carry a founder-gated hold inside them and are read as failed until it closes, and rows 157, 162, and 165 are read at the first reset as well as the gate. Session 17's assembly inherits: the review page (A13) and the mechanics page (A12) as the wiki's review and pay pages beside the destinations page (86akht1m9), the feedback culture page (17tn048qck5), and the communication architecture page (S11 I1), with the parameters register on the partners' page and never on the wiki; eleven instrument specifications that extend earlier sessions' (I1 extends S4's person page and S9's career conversation block; I2 extends S4's placement and S12's placed check-in trigger; I3 extends S12's coaching form; I4 extends S4's person page and S5's transparency sheet; I5 extends S3's registers and S5's item 6; I6 extends S5's seat sheet; I7 extends S4's loop-closure window and S11's channel; I8 sits under S7's module standard beside S12's coaching module; I10 extends S11's reach read record; I11 extends S5's transparency sheet) and must be assembled as one instrument each; two vocabulary lines as audit rules beside the "operating system," "diagnostic," and "feedback" lines (86akh5uym; S11 P27; S12 finding 18.3): "the review," unqualified, is the person's review and every other review is named in full, and "points," unqualified, is the pay system's word and appears on no other surface, so that no recognition, designation, or channel item is ever described with it; the rule that no review output and no feedback act reaches pay and the point system reads four inputs on records (A26, A27) beside Session 6's four dimensions, Session 9's order of every read, Session 10's no-person-in-a-room rule, Session 11's record-first rule, and Session 12's no-page rule; the transparency sheet's item 6 as a mechanism with values set or unset, assembled from I5 and never from anywhere else; and thirteen findings, four of which surface from a narrow read of the white paper's review paragraph and pay section and nine of which need the record against the transparency line, the service model, the daypart thesis, the stack's open decisions, and both canon artifacts, for the assembly's conflicts list, including the finding that "exploitation" is undefined in both canon artifacts as "toxicity" is (S12 18.9), for the same ruling. This extends 17tn048qck2, 17tn048qc2j, 86akht3fx, 86akhpvvq, and 86akhcz7t and does not repeat them. High.
